title: UW–Madison Brand Identity for Quarto PDF
text: Use inside ```{=latex} blocks .qmd:
code: \badgerred{text}          % Badger Red inline text color \darkred{text}            % Dark Red inline text color  \uwicon{filename}{height}              % Brand icon at given height \uwillustration{filename}{width}       % Brand illustration at given width \uwiconinline{filename}                % Icon sized to current line height  \begin{uwbox}[Title]   ... \end{uwbox}      % Red callout box \begin{uwinfo}[Title]  ... \end{uwinfo}     % Gray info box \begin{uwaccent}[Title] ... \end{uwaccent}  % Dark red accent box ```{=latex} \begin{uwbox}[Key Takeaway] Content of the box goes here. \end{uwbox} ```

title: UW–Madison Brand Identity for Quarto PDF
code: source("R/theme_uw.R")  # Individual color lookup uw_color("badger_red")           # "#C5050C" uw_color("dark_red", "yellow")   # named vector  # Discrete scales scale_color_uw() scale_fill_uw()  # Continuous (sequential) scales — light gray → Badger Red scale_color_uw_c() scale_fill_uw_c()  # Theme — use alone or combine with the scales above theme_uw()                       # Crimson Pro body, Red Hat Display headings theme_uw(base_size = 12) theme_uw(grid = "x")            # "both" | "x" | "y" | "none" theme_uw(title_color = "black") # override title color

title: Getting Started with uwbranding
text: official colors named vector uw_colors. Use uw_color() retrieve specific values name. glance:
code: uw_colors #> badger_red      white   dark_red light_gray      black     yellow  gray_blue  #>  "#C5050C"  "#FFFFFF"  "#9B0000"  "#E1E5E7"  "#121212"  "#FFBF00"  "#6B9999"  #>       blue  #>  "#386666" uw_color("badger_red") #> badger_red  #>  "#C5050C" uw_color("badger_red", "dark_red", "light_gray") #> badger_red   dark_red light_gray  #>  "#C5050C"  "#9B0000"  "#E1E5E7"

title: Getting Started with uwbranding
text: theme_uw() default theme PDF documents light-background slides. pairs Badger Red headings clean white panel.  grid argument controls gridlines shown ("", "x", "y", "none"). bar charts, grid = "x" usually cleaner.  title_color accepts color name uw_colors raw hex string — useful Badger Red doesn’t contrast enough content:
code: ggplot(mpg, aes(x = displ, y = hwy, color = drv)) +   geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +   scale_color_uw(labels = c("4-wheel", "Front", "Rear")) +   labs(     title    = "Engine Displacement vs. Highway MPG",     subtitle = "Motor Trend Car Road Tests",     x        = "Displacement (L)",     y        = "Highway MPG",     color    = "Drive",     caption  = "Source: ggplot2::mpg"   ) +   theme_uw() mpg |>   count(manufacturer) |>   slice_max(n, n = 10) |>   ggplot(aes(x = n, y = reorder(manufacturer, n))) +   geom_col(fill = uw_color("badger_red")) +   labs(title = "Top 10 Manufacturers", x = "Count", y = NULL) +   theme_uw(grid = "x") ggplot(mpg, aes(x = hwy)) +   geom_histogram(fill = uw_color("dark_red"), bins = 20) +   labs(title = "Highway MPG Distribution", x = "Highway MPG", y = "Count") +   theme_uw(title_color = "black")

title: Getting Started with uwbranding
text: scale_color_uw() scale_fill_uw() apply [uw_palette_discrete] — ordered visibility white:
code: mpg |>   count(manufacturer, drv) |>   ggplot(aes(x = n, y = reorder(manufacturer, n), fill = drv)) +   geom_col() +   scale_fill_uw(labels = c("4-wheel", "Front", "Rear")) +   facet_wrap(~drv, labeller = as_labeller(     c(`4` = "4-Wheel", f = "Front", r = "Rear")   )) +   labs(title = "Vehicles by Manufacturer & Drive Type",        x = "Count", y = NULL) +   theme_uw(grid = "x") +   theme(legend.position = "none")

title: Getting Started with uwbranding
text: scale_fill_uw_c() scale_color_uw_c() run UW Light Gray Badger Red:
code: ggplot(faithfuld, aes(waiting, eruptions, fill = density)) +   geom_tile() +   scale_fill_uw_c() +   labs(title = "Old Faithful Eruption Density",        x = "Waiting (min)", y = "Eruption (min)") +   theme_uw(grid = "none")

title: Getting Started with uwbranding
text: theme_uw_dark() designed slides poster panels. Two styles available via style argument.

title: Getting Started with uwbranding
text: Near-black background (#121212) Badger Red title — versatile dark option.
code: ggplot(mpg, aes(x = displ, y = hwy, color = drv)) +   geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.9) +   scale_color_uw_dark(labels = c("4-wheel", "Front", "Rear")) +   labs(     title    = "Engine Displacement vs. Highway MPG",     subtitle = "Motor Trend Car Road Tests",     x        = "Displacement (L)",     y        = "Highway MPG",     color    = "Drive"   ) +   theme_uw_dark()

title: Getting Started with uwbranding
text: Badger Red background (#C5050C) white text — high-impact title slides poster headers.
code: mpg |>   count(manufacturer) |>   slice_max(n, n = 8) |>   ggplot(aes(x = n, y = reorder(manufacturer, n))) +   geom_col(fill = "white") +   labs(title = "Top Manufacturers", x = "Count", y = NULL) +   theme_uw_dark(style = "red", grid = "x")

title: Getting Started with uwbranding
text: scale_fill_uw_dark_c() runs Badger Red → White, suited dark panels:
code: ggplot(faithfuld, aes(waiting, eruptions, fill = density)) +   geom_tile() +   scale_fill_uw_dark_c() +   labs(title = "Old Faithful Eruption Density",        x = "Waiting (min)", y = "Eruption (min)") +   theme_uw_dark(grid = "none")

title: Getting Started with uwbranding
text: use_uw_pdf(), use_uw_revealjs(), use_uw_beamer() copy starter templates project directory. Run per project, render normally quarto render.
code: # PDF document (copies uw-brand.tex, _quarto.yml, template.qmd) use_uw_pdf()  # RevealJS presentation (copies _uw-light.scss, _uw-dark.scss, template.qmd) use_uw_revealjs()  # Beamer/PDF presentation (copies _uw-beamer-preamble.tex, title.tex, template.qmd) use_uw_beamer()  # All three default to getwd(). Use path = to target a subdirectory. use_uw_revealjs(path = "slides")  # Use overwrite = TRUE to refresh files from the package. use_uw_pdf(overwrite = TRUE)

what: uwbranding: UW-Madison Brand Identity for R and Quarto — uwbranding-package
title: uwbranding: UW-Madison Brand Identity for R and Quarto — uwbranding-package
text: Provides ggplot2 themes, color palettes, Quarto document templates conforming University Wisconsin-Madison brand identity. Includes light dark variants PDF documents, RevealJS presentations, Beamer slides. Quarto template files copied user projects via use_uw_pdf(), use_uw_revealjs(), use_uw_beamer().

title: uwbranding: UW-Madison Brand Identity for R and Quarto — uwbranding-package
text: Maintainer: First Last author@wisc.edu

title: uwbranding 0.1.0
text: Initial release. theme_uw() theme_uw_dark() provide ggplot2 themes using UW–Madison brand identity. scale_color_uw(), scale_fill_uw(), scale_color_uw_c(), scale_fill_uw_c() provide discrete continuous color scales. scale_color_uw_dark(), scale_fill_uw_dark(), scale_color_uw_dark_c(), scale_fill_uw_dark_c() provide scales optimised dark backgrounds. uw_color() retrieves brand hex codes name. use_uw_pdf(), use_uw_revealjs(), use_uw_beamer() copy Quarto templates user projects.
